title: Halal Cart Chicken and Rice
equip: Instant Pot, stainless steel skillet with lid (or a plate/pot lid that fits), hand whisk or Philips whisk attachment

items.sub: 60 g Tabasco or extra Sriracha plus 1 tsp white vinegar

items.n: lettuce (little gem, romaine or iceberg), medium diced

steps.x: Whisk the 25 g yogurt, 15 g lemon juice, 15 ml olive oil, 10 g salt and all the chicken spices into a smooth paste. Toss the thighs until fully coated. Refrigerate 30 min if you have time. Otherwise it marinates while the rice cooks.
Rinse the basmati in a colander until the water runs clear. Drain well, about 5 min, so the water ratio stays accurate.
Set the Instant Pot to Sauté (Normal). Add 3 tbsp oil and heat 2 min until shimmering. Add the rice and toast 4 min, stirring constantly, until most grains turn opaque and a few start to colour.
Stir in the butter and turmeric for 1 min until the butter melts and the rice turns yellow.

Add the water, crumbled Knorr cubes, 5 g onion powder and 5 g garlic powder. Stir until dissolved. Scrape the bottom well so no grains or spices stick (this prevents the Burn notice). Level the rice, then press Cancel.

Lock the lid, set the valve to Sealing, and cook on High pressure for 4 min. Start the chicken (next steps) as soon as the lid is on. When the pot beeps, let it release naturally for 10 min, then quick release. Fluff with a fork and keep covered.
Heat the skillet over medium-high. Add 2 tbsp oil. Lay the thighs in smooth side down, press with a spatula, and sear undisturbed 5 min until deep golden. Flip and sear 2 min.
Reduce to low, cover the skillet, and cook 8 min. Cut into the thickest thigh to check: no pink, juices clear (85°C if you use a probe).
While the chicken cooks, whisk the white sauce ingredients until smooth and pourable. Mix the Sriracha and hot sauce in a separate bowl. Dice the lettuce and tomatoes.
Move the chicken to a plate and rest 10 min. Add 30 ml water to the skillet, scrape up the browned bits and simmer 1 min. Fish out any burnt bits first.
Dice the rested thighs into 2 cm chunks and toss through the pan jus. Pour any plate drippings over.
Spoon rice into bowls. Top with chicken, lettuce and tomato, then drizzle with white sauce and red sauce.

notes: Oven finish swapped for a covered skillet. The chicken is juicier but less crusty than the original. For crisper edges, move the seared thighs to the air fryer at 200°C for 6 min instead of covering the pan.
Rice liquid is reduced from the original stovetop ratio to suit the Instant Pot. If you get a Burn notice, add 30 ml water next time and scrape the bottom harder.
Better Than Bouillon is hard to find in Singapore, so Knorr cubes are used. Check the rice for salt before serving and adjust the white sauce salt if needed.
Spicy: the red sauce is very hot. Keep it separate, and plate the child's portion first with white sauce only.
Meal prep (4 portions): store rice and chicken together in a Glasslock for 4 days in the fridge. Keep both sauces in separate small containers. Add lettuce and tomato fresh on the day.
Reheat: rice with 1 tbsp water, microwave 2 min. Chicken 1 min. Add sauces and veg after reheating.
Leftover white sauce keeps 4 days and works as a wrap or burrito sauce.
source: Brian Lagerstrom, Halal Cart Chicken and Rice (adapted for Instant Pot + stovetop)
